White stockings and tall glossy black boots with subtle gold edging. One compact folded olive-green Japanese paper parasol attached behind the shoulder as a single connected prop. Calm reserved expression. Single human character only, no rover, trees, bench, stool, vase, falling leaves, scenery, or detached decorations.
